notes.title: Armless Samurai Quality of Life Update #1
notes.content:
[u][b]Here is the first quality of life update for Armless Samurai! We have added & refined a few features, fixed various bugs,and have added official ultrawide support. [/b][/u]

[b]New Features:[/b]
- Gong sounds have been added! You can now kick, dive, and dash into the gong to make a really loud noise.
- A Grade meter has been added to the results screen to give more information on your grade. You will now see the scores required to achieve each grade with a little meter so achieving SSS will be a bit easier to visualize.
- A quick restart feature has been added to assist with speedrunners. You can turn this on in the gameplay settings menu. With this option turned on, you can now press a hotkey when the game is paused to restart the level
- Ultrawide support has been added (there was a lot of work that went into this)

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed a bug that prevented certain enemies from giving you a score bonus when parrying them 
- Fixed a bug that occasionally prevented the player from healing when parrying sniper bullets 
- Fixed a minor bug with parrying
- Fixed various minor bugs

[b]Misc Fixes:[/b]
- Removed obsolete key bindings 
- Renamed some control bindings
- Train no longer DDOS's Steam's achievement servers
- Adjusted size of tutorial text prompts
- The train no longer shows up when using controller.
- Improved auto-selection of UI elements after closing some UI panels
- long usernames no longer break the entire leaderboard
- improved controller modification of UI sliders
- improved support for controller and keyboard navigation in the resolution dropdown
